scope: Only the two Elena garden-door sills, short photographed Dalí frontage and two visible drains. South approach terrain is in data/terrain.json. Small details are optional; player heights use these same outlines.

sills.name: Elena south · photographed garden-door sill 1
sills.trust: Positions estimated against the existing lawn/door-approach outline and unchanged registry facade in the georeferenced Esri aerial; about 1-2 m plan uncertainty. Photos support these two distinct garden doors only; sill width/depth and 0.12 m rise are estimated within the 0.10-0.15 m survey range. No house floors or unphotographed doors are raised. A finite closed brown leaf and short white surround back this sill; surround dimensions and rear setback are estimated, with no complete garden enclosure inferred.

surfaces.name: Dalí · bounded house-side footpath at photographed arch
surfaces.trust: Only the visible 9 m facade run is represented, parallel to the unchanged registry front near the IMG_2291 camera. Phone pin overlaps the house within its ±5.6 m uncertainty; it is not the subject coordinate. Surface relationship and 0.10-0.15 m parking kerb rise are photo-supported; strip ends/width/position estimated to 1-2 m. The arch lies in a large unsplit registry part; its internal passage is not newly cut or claimed accessible.

surfaces.name: Dalí · photographed lawn between footpath and parking kerb
surfaces.trust: Narrow lawn band separates house footpath from parking kerb as photographed; bounded to the same short facade run. Width .95 m and plan endpoints are approximate, not a continuous surveyed Dalí strip.

kerbs.name: Dalí · parking-facing kerb beyond the lawn
kerbs.trust: White kerb on the asphalt-facing side of the lawn, not between lawn and house footpath; estimated 0.12 m rise, limited to the photographed frontage.

drains.name: Dalí · flush arch threshold slot drain
drains.trust: Dark slot across the passage mouth, flush with the adjacent footpath; approximate position on the short visible facade run, not a new claimed walk-through.

drains.name: Dalí · photographed lane-entry slot drain
drains.trust: Slot across the tiled lane inside the parking apron. Placed at the existing Patricia start by registry/road alignment, within camera ±5 m; the photo does not show a readable street name, so identification remains inferred.

datums.note: Finite movement-only datum reconciliation around the new features: sills stand on the existing .025 m frontage paving; Dali surfaces stand on the existing .27 m roads. Within 1 m, soles match those visible datums; the next 2 m blend back to the inherited player datum. This outer blend is a movement approximation, not photographed terrain. Solid house interiors and pools are excluded; remote roads retain their inherited mesh/player mismatch.

gardenDoor.note: Two finite closed brown garden-door leaves with short white jamb/head surrounds are directly visible in 2260/2261/2330. Each surround stops at its own 1.55 m width; no enclosure or connecting wall is inferred. Width, height and .09 m rear setback from sill edge are estimates.
